title: A flaw in Node.js Permission Model filesystem enforcement can grant access to paths that do not match a wildcard…
description: A vulnerability in the Node.js permission model for filesystem enforcement allows access to paths that do not match a specified wildcard pattern. This flaw could lead to unauthorized access to filesystem paths beyond intended restrictions. The issue is identified in Microsoft-related software, specifically version 3.0. No CVSS score or detailed exploit information is currently available.
